{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Actually the service is better at Flarestar, but I prefer the decor at Hyperspace.|Corran Horn|<ref name="BW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref>}}
The '''Hyperspace''' was a [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe]] on the [[Yag'Dhul space station]] frequented by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] during the [[Bacta War]]. Operated by a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]], it was known for its vibrant and somewhat overpowering decor. The food was supposed to be unrecognizable but edible.<ref name="BW" />
